title: The Knowledge Store
brief: Teach the agent your business language. On your Wealth & Distribution agent:
- Author 8 SQL expressions: 3 filters, 4 measures, 1 field. A measure defined once
here cannot drift the way a number retyped into five dashboards does.
- Give every measure a display name, so what Genie shows matches what people say.
- Declare the join relationships rather than leaving Genie to work them out.
- Add synonyms for 10 business terms — AUM, AUA, net new money, equities, cash.
Then re-run the questions that failed in Lab 4 and show which now pass.
Ceiling to respect: 200 knowledge store snippets per agent, shared between table
descriptions, join relationships and SQL expressions.
NOTE ON GRADING. The SQL expressions are checked automatically. Synonyms and joins are
not, because a Genie space's payload has no field for either — they live in entity
matching and in the metric view's YAML, neither of which is readable back through the
API or information_schema. Those two are reviewed by a human. Do not skip them: they
are what turns 'net new money' into a query that runs.

checks.name: 8 or more SQL expressions
checks.hint: Filters, measures and fields all count toward the eight.

checks.name: At least 3 filters
checks.hint: Settled only, exclude exchanges, discretionary only.

checks.name: At least 4 measures
checks.hint: AUM, AUA, held-away and net flows are the four that get argued about.

checks.name: At least 1 field expression
checks.hint: A derived field, such as the signed flow amount.

checks.name: Every measure carries a display name
checks.hint: aum_usd is a column name. 'AUM' is what the business calls it.
